items.name: Field dressing
items.description: A sealed dressing. Restores {amount} health at once, and the wound keeps mending for a while after.

items.name: Loose cartridges
items.description: {amount} cartridges in a paper packet. Transfers up to {amount} rounds to your ammunition reserve.

items.name: Binding incense
items.description: A waxed incense packet. Restores {amount} charge to the shared summon reserve, and its smoke wards you for a while.

items.name: Hotel matches
items.description: A booklet of the hotel's own matches. Strike one to carry a small flame for a while.

items.name: Smelling salts
items.description: A stoppered bottle of salts. One breath steadies your nerve and sharpens your senses: you feel residents stirring nearby, even through walls.

items.name: Survey reel
items.description: The WEST WING survey reel, recovered from its blue case. Bring it back to the refuge.

items.name: Ledger page
items.description: A page torn from the hotel register, the names on it still wet. Bring it back to the refuge.
